about_the_game:
Get ready to Qube.

Qubx2 is a high-intensity 3D puzzle experience that fuses lightning-fast spatial reasoning with a retro-cyberpunk atmosphere. In this successor to the original Qubx, your mission is deceptively simple: rotate a cube to align the correct geometric face with incoming shapes. But as neon projectiles streak toward you from five directions simultaneously, accompanied by pulsing laser trajectory indicators and explosive particle effects, you'll discover that simplicity and ease are two very different things.

Scoring & Progression

- Combo System: Chain successful matches to build score multipliers from 1.1x up to 2.0x

- Lives-Based Challenge: Start with 10 hearts and fight to maintain your streak as difficulty ramps up

- Persistent Leaderboards: Compete for high scores with name entry and permanent ranking system

- Level Advancement: Every 10 successful matches increases speed and complexity

- Steam Deck Ready: Automatic detection with tailored controls and UI scaling for handheld play

Whether you're seeking a quick adrenaline rush or aiming to master the leaderboards, Qubx2 delivers an addictive blend of geometric puzzles, neon aesthetics, and pulsing neofunk energy. The Qube is calling. Are you ready to answer?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent, SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz x86_64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible graphics card with 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
